name: Ether no Sunadokei ~Angel Time~
original_name: エーテルの砂時計～ANGEL TIME～
source:
There is a town on the border of two worlds where lost things gather. 
Main character belongs to the faction of town protectors. He died and then got resurrected, so all his power is lost now. He decides to live like a normal person in the circle of friends, but things start to change around him...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在两个世界的交界处，有一座失物汇聚的城镇。
主人公属于守护城镇的阵营。他曾经死去，后来又得以复活，因此如今已经失去全部力量。他决定与朋友们一起过普通人的生活，但身边的事物开始悄然发生变化…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
